name: synthetic_press
register: third-person documentary narration, restrained and authoritative; people are seen, not heard
style_suffix: cinematic film still, photorealistic, restrained documentary realism, muted desaturated color grade, ash grey and pale amber, cold steel blues in interiors, natural available light, soft directional light with rich detail in shadows, high dynamic range, sombre and still, high production value, sharp focus, crisp detail, full-frame 16:9 composition, no letterboxing, no black bars, no text, no letters
default_music_prompt: Restrained, tense cinematic underscore for a prestige documentary about technology, ambition and power. A low sustained synth drone, sparse piano, faint pulse of unease. Modern and controlled — not orchestral-melodramatic. Builds quiet tension under a narrator without ever competing with the voice. Cool, intelligent, foreboding.
notes: Synthetic Press flagship. AI-documentary, 'AI-drama not AI-doom'. Palette: navy #0a1628, amber #d4a017, bone #f4f1ea, rust #8b3a1e. Two-mode visuals: Mode A cinematic recreation (this engine) + Mode B Remotion graphics. Voice Victor as placeholder; real human-voice swap via finish --assemble-only true-up. Renders 1920x1080 to match Mode B. Created June 2026, OpenAI series launch.
default_motion: slow deliberate camera movement, restrained and steady, natural realistic motion, quiet atmosphere

thumbnail.candidate_prompt_suffix: YouTube thumbnail composition, strongly asymmetric: the single atmospheric subject (a dark lighthouse, an empty ship, a frozen wreck, an eruption across a bay) is massed in the RIGHT TWO-THIRDS of the frame; the LEFT THIRD is deliberately dark, shadowed, low-detail negative space reserved for a headline; mournful cinematic dread, deep shadow, cold muted palette, the subject lit against the dark left; faceless, no people in detail, no text, no letters
selection_rules: ONE clear atmospheric subject that reads instantly at phone-thumbnail size
mournful, high-contrast cinematic dread — it must stand out in a dim feed without being loud
faceless: no resolved human faces, no figures in detail
clean, darker, uncluttered negative space in the TOP-LEFT where the headline lands
no garbled detail, no accidental letterforms, no duplicated or broken figures, one subject only

_style_suffix_gettysburg: epic cinematic blockbuster film still, photorealistic, dramatic teal and orange color grade, vivid saturated color, intense dramatic lighting, bright vivid exposure with rich detail in shadows, high dynamic range, anamorphic lens flare, crisp and dynamic, lots of light and energy, high production value, sharp focus, crisp detail, full-frame 16:9 composition, no letterboxing, no black bars, no text, no letters
_default_motion_gettysburg: dynamic cinematic camera movement, powerful momentum, natural realistic motion, dramatic atmosphere
